data.action: 双手按住发丝回眸微笑，海风吹起裙角
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 江之岛海风】蔚蓝的大海泛着波光粼粼的浪花，江之岛海风卷起白色水手服的裙摆。后藤一里扶着海滨栏杆，双手紧紧按住被风吹乱的发丝，回眸看向镜头，羞涩而灿烂的微笑在夏日晴空下格外动人——「大家一起看到的大海……比我想象中要辽阔几千倍呢。」
data.lighting: 夏日海滨明朗阳光与海面高光反光
data.promptProse: Hitori pauses at the seaside railing in her white summer sailor shirt, navy collar and neat dark pleated skirt. She lifts both hands to tame her windblown pink hair and looks back with a shy smile. The eye-level medium view keeps the railing beside her and the broad Enoshima sea beyond. Clear summer light brightens the white shirt and ribbon, with water reflections softly filling her shaded face.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 江之岛海风
